verdicts.reason: A keeps the full lockup (headline with the gold leaf wreath) centred on a calm dark area, so the brand survives. But the whole thing is tiny in a 768x71 banner, with lots of dead space and the food image cropped to a blur, so the headline is barely readable. B has the headline text slightly larger, but the gold wreath is split off and stranded on the right, drifting over the busy fig. The headline is left floating, without its decoration, off-centre and small. That breaks the brand lockup and looks like a bug.
